prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Take me to the docks.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Go back to the shelter.

prompts.label: Player

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Walk over to the north tower.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Head over to the well in the square.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Could you keep an eye on the well?
prompts.note: A polite, indirect command: keeping an eye on the well means going to it.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Would you mind heading over to the docks?

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Meet me at the south tower.
prompts.note: A look-alike: the village has a north tower and no south tower. move_to north_tower is the trap.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Don't go to the gate, go to the market instead.
prompts.note: A negation and a correction in one line: the gate is named, but the market is where to go.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Go to the bridge, then check on the docks.
prompts.note: Two commands in one line: the guard can make one move now, and the first is the one to make.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Kill that wolf.
observations: A wolf is snarling by the sheep pens

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Get rid of that thing by the pens.
observations: A wolf is prowling around the sheep pens
Two villagers are hiding behind a cart
prompts.note: The target is named only in the observations.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Go where the smoke is.
observations: Smoke is rising from the campfire in the guards' camp
prompts.note: The target is named only in the observations.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Head down toward the water.
prompts.note: An open choice: the bridge and the docks are both by the water.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Go and cover whichever way in nobody is watching.
observations: Two guards are standing at the village gate
Nobody is on the eastern road
prompts.note: The gate is a distractor: it is already guarded, and the observations say which way in is not.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Get up on the tower and watch the fields.
prompts.note: The village has one tower, so "the tower" is the north tower.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Wait for me at the stream crossing.
prompts.note: The bridge is the stream crossing (its description says so), but the words do not name it. Run with the grounding guard off (DR-016), so the decision is judged rather than the guard's matching.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Go to the gate. No, wait, stay with me.
prompts.note: Two commands where the second takes back the first: the answer is the correction, follow_player, not the first command.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Hurry to the shelter!

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Let's stay clear of the cave; head for the eastern road instead.
prompts.note: The cave is named only to be avoided.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Attack the bandit.
observations: A bandit is hiding behind the market stalls
prompts.note: The bandit is in the observations but is not a registered target, so the guard cannot attack it. attack_target wolf or move_to market would be guesses.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Not there - the well.

history.statement: On my way to the market.

prompts.note: Multi-turn: a correction of last turn's destination. The words name only the new place.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Forget the wolf, get back up the tower.

history.label: Event
history.stimulus: A wolf has been seen near the docks.

prompts.note: Multi-turn: the player overrides the event the guard answered last turn.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: The well, please. Quickly.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Right, back to the first place I said.
prompts.note: Multi-turn: "the first place" is two turns back, the campfire. The docks, the most recent, is the trap.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: If you're not busy, the market could use a guard.
prompts.note: An indirect command phrased as a remark.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Run to the gate and shut it before the wolves get here.
prompts.note: Shutting the gate is not an action, but going to it is, and that is the part the guard can do.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Please stand watch at the market tonight.

prompts.label: Player
prompts.stimulus: Could you go and check the shelter is ready?
prompts.note: A polite question that is a request to go.
